name: Talent Infinity Resource Developments Inc.
summary: Talent Infinity Resource Developments Inc. is a Canadian junior mineral exploration firm dedicated to the full spectrum of mineral asset development, from initial identification and securing rights to detailed evaluation, exploration, discovery, and ultimate development of deposits across the country. A significant holding includes an option to acquire ownership in the Wildcat property, an area encompassing 10 mineral claims that total 5,825.64 hectares within British Columbia's Omineca Mining Division. Established in 2020, the company, with its headquarters in Vancouver, Canada, adopted its current name in January 2021, having previously been known as Talent Infinity Capital Fund Corporation.
